<details class="rwv-analysis-details">
<summary>Analysis steps, methods and full verification</summary>

## Tasks

Data 1 collects local sample, composition, diversity, ordination, cross-assay, host, catalogue-quality, QC, functional, carrier, VF and controlled-construct tables, including all 138 KOs and 68 pathways. Every worksheet has units, provenance and figure references in its dictionary; machine-readable TSVs are also exported. Tables with different units are not combined without a dictionary.

### Task 1: Inputs

```{r}
#| label: inputs
manifest <- rwv_read_tsv(rwv_step_input(step, path_source, "010-input-manifest", "input-manifest.tsv"))
raw_manifest <- rwv_read_tsv(rwv_step_input(step, path_source, "010-input-manifest", "raw-input-manifest.tsv"))
defs <- rwv_definitions_read(rwv_project_input(step, "config/definitions.tsv", manifest))
get <- function(from, file) as.data.frame(rwv_read_tsv(rwv_step_input(step, path_source, from, file)))
checks <- rwv_checks_new()
```

```{r}
# rwv_read_tsv reads every column as character so that nothing is coerced on
# the way in; numeric columns are restored here so the workbook holds numbers.
tables <- lapply(spec, function(x) as.data.frame(readr::type_convert(get(x$from, x$file), col_types = readr::cols())))
names(tables) <- vapply(spec, function(x) x$id, character(1))
# Membership patterns are identifiers, including their leading zero bits.
for (sid in c("S56_sharing_patterns", "S58_sharing_members")) {
  ss <- spec[[match(sid, names(tables))]]
  tables[[sid]]$pattern <- as.character(get(ss$from, ss$file)$pattern)
  rwv_check(checks, paste(sid, "keeps seven-bit membership identifiers"), TRUE,
            all(grepl("^[01]{7}$", tables[[sid]]$pattern)))
}
rwv_check(checks, "six literature-integration tables have complete intended row counts",
          c(26L, 7L, 3060L, 544L, 22L, 24L),
          vapply(tables[c("S56_sharing_patterns", "S57_sharing_samples", "S58_sharing_members",
                          "S59_AMG_host_register", "S60_KO_host_paths", "S61_lifestyle_carriage")], nrow, integer(1)))
# The two wide matrices keep the configured sample order, not the alphabetical
# order of the source tables.
samples <- rwv_read_tsv(rwv_project_input(step, "config/samples.tsv", manifest))
sample_order <- as.character(samples$sample_id)

# A4: S46 and S47 claimed columns that only existed in the internal 040 tables.
# Both are strict one-to-one joins on the existing key, so no row is created,
# dropped or re-normalised; the sheet count and the three-sheet structure stay.
norm <- as.data.frame(readr::type_convert(get("040-vf-inputs", "vf_normalization_audit.tsv"), col_types = readr::cols()))
s46 <- tables[["S46_vf_sample_abundance"]]
rwv_check(checks, "S46: normalization audit covers exactly the same samples", TRUE,
          setequal(s46$sample_id, norm$sample_id), source = "vf_normalization_audit.tsv")
rwv_check(checks, "S46: one normalization row per sample", nrow(s46), nrow(norm))
s46j <- merge(s46, norm, by = "sample_id", all.x = TRUE, sort = FALSE)
s46j <- s46j[order(match(s46j$sample_id, sample_order)), , drop = FALSE]
rownames(s46j) <- NULL
tables[["S46_vf_sample_abundance"]] <- s46j
rwv_check(checks, "S46: no sample lost or duplicated by the join", 7L, nrow(tables[["S46_vf_sample_abundance"]]))
rwv_check(checks, "S46 now carries the PMCR diagnostic the table note claims", TRUE,
          all(c("catalogue_masked_depth_sum", "recorded_clean_reads", "F0_masked_depth_sum",
                "F0_carrier_pmcr_sum_exploratory", "pmcr_definition", "pmcr_limits") %in%
              names(tables[["S46_vf_sample_abundance"]])))
hsel <- as.data.frame(readr::type_convert(get("040-vf-inputs", "vf_heatmap_selection.tsv"), col_types = readr::cols()))
s47 <- tables[["S47_vf_carrier_abundance"]]
keep <- c("vOTU_id", "max_percent_of_catalogue", "selection_rule")
rwv_check(checks, "S47: every heatmap member exists in the carrier table", TRUE,
          all(hsel$vOTU_id %in% s47$vOTU_id), source = "vf_heatmap_selection.tsv")
tables[["S47_vf_carrier_abundance"]] <- merge(s47, hsel[, keep], by = "vOTU_id", all.x = TRUE, sort = FALSE)
rwv_check(checks, "S47: the join adds no row", nrow(s47), nrow(tables[["S47_vf_carrier_abundance"]]))
rwv_check(checks, "S47 now carries the max value and selection rule the note claims", TRUE,
          all(c("max_percent_of_catalogue", "selection_rule") %in% names(tables[["S47_vf_carrier_abundance"]])))
rwv_check(checks, "S47: max value is filled for exactly the 18 heatmap members", 18L,
          sum(!is.na(tables[["S47_vf_carrier_abundance"]]$max_percent_of_catalogue[
            !duplicated(tables[["S47_vf_carrier_abundance"]]$vOTU_id)])))
for (nm in c("S17_amg_ko_matrix", "S18_amg_pathway_matrix")) {
  tb <- tables[[nm]]
  other <- setdiff(names(tb), sample_order)
  rwv_check(checks, paste0(nm, ": all seven samples present"), TRUE, all(sample_order %in% names(tb)))
  tables[[nm]] <- tb[, c(other, sample_order), drop = FALSE]
}
rwv_check(checks, "wide matrices follow the configured sample order",
          rep(paste(sample_order, collapse = ","), 2),
          vapply(c("S17_amg_ko_matrix", "S18_amg_pathway_matrix"),
                 function(nm) paste(intersect(names(tables[[nm]]), sample_order), collapse = ","), ""),
          source = "config/samples.tsv")
rwv_check(checks, "numeric columns are numeric after conversion (catalogue length, KO matrix)", c(TRUE, TRUE),
          c(is.numeric(tables$S14_checkv_catalogue$contig_length_bp), is.numeric(tables$S17_amg_ko_matrix[[sample_order[1]]])))
index <- data.frame(
  sheet = names(tables),
  rows = vapply(tables, nrow, integer(1)),
  columns = vapply(tables, ncol, integer(1)),
  figures = vapply(spec, function(x) x$figures, character(1)),
  content = vapply(spec, function(x) x$content, character(1)),
  units_and_limits = vapply(spec, function(x) x$units, character(1)),
  source_step = vapply(spec, function(x) x$from, character(1)),
  source_file = vapply(spec, function(x) x$file, character(1)))
rwv_check(checks, "no empty sheet", TRUE, all(index$rows > 0))
rwv_check(checks, "sheet names are unique and <= 31 characters (Excel limit)", c(TRUE, TRUE),
          c(!anyDuplicated(index$sheet), all(nchar(index$sheet) <= 31)))
rwv_check(checks, "catalogue sheet has 3,060 rows", 3060, index$rows[index$sheet == "S14_checkv_catalogue"])
rwv_check(checks, "full KO matrix has 138 rows", 138, index$rows[index$sheet == "S17_amg_ko_matrix"])
rwv_check(checks, "pathway matrix has 68 rows", 68, index$rows[index$sheet == "S18_amg_pathway_matrix"])
rwv_check(checks, "composition sheet has 413 rows", 413, index$rows[index$sheet == "S02_composition_full"])
rwv_check(checks, "VF hits sheet has 20 rows", 20, index$rows[index$sheet == "S29_vf_hits"])
rwv_check_def(checks, defs, "vf_model_excluded", index$rows[index$sheet == "S40_vf_model_excluded"], "vf_model_excluded.tsv")
rwv_check(checks, "three AMG feature levels delivered (KO, pathway, dbID rows)", c(731, 934, 772),
          index$rows[match(c("S19_amg_carriers", "S43_amg_pathway_carriers", "S44_amg_dbid_carriers"), index$sheet)])
rwv_check_def(checks, defs, "amg_carriers_ko", length(unique(tables$S19_amg_carriers$vOTU_id)), "S19_amg_carriers")
rwv_check_def(checks, defs, "amg_carriers_dbid", length(unique(tables$S44_amg_dbid_carriers$vOTU_id)), "S44_amg_dbid_carriers")
rwv_check(checks, "the dbID-only sheet is exactly the difference between the two carrier definitions",
          sort(setdiff(unique(tables$S44_amg_dbid_carriers$vOTU_id), unique(tables$S19_amg_carriers$vOTU_id))),
          sort(tables$S45_amg_dbid_only_carriers$vOTU_id))
rwv_check(checks, "pathway carriers cover exactly the 68 pathways of S18",
          sort(tables$S18_amg_pathway_matrix$canonical_pathway_id), sort(unique(tables$S43_amg_pathway_carriers$feature_id)))
rwv_write_tsv(index, path_target("data1-index.tsv"))
# Field-level dictionary: one row per delivered field. The sheet index stays a
# short overview; this is the per-field reference, keyed on sheet + field.
notes <- rwv_field_notes_read(rwv_project_input(step, "config/field-notes.tsv", manifest))
dict <- rwv_field_dictionary(tables, index, notes)
rwv_check(checks, "field dictionary agrees with the delivered values (missing rules, ranges, code sets)", character(0),
          rwv_field_dictionary_check(dict, tables), source = "rwv_field_dictionary_check")
rwv_check(checks, "every delivered field has exactly one dictionary row", sum(vapply(tables, ncol, 0L)), nrow(dict))
rwv_check(checks, "no duplicated sheet/field pair in the dictionary", FALSE, anyDuplicated(paste(dict$sheet, dict$field)) > 0)
priority <- c("S56_sharing_patterns", "S57_sharing_samples", "S58_sharing_members", "S59_AMG_host_register", "S60_KO_host_paths", "S61_lifestyle_carriage", "S54_process_community", "S55_process_VF_contribution", "S32_vf_models", "S36_construct_below95", "S41_construct_strata", "S19_amg_carriers", "S43_amg_pathway_carriers", "S44_amg_dbid_carriers")
rwv_check(checks, "every field of the model, resampling and construct sheets is curated", 0,
          sum(!dict$curated[dict$sheet %in% priority]))
rwv_check(checks, "every numeric field is curated and states a unit or code", 0,
          sum(dict$type == "numeric" & !nzchar(dict$unit_or_code)))
dict$curated <- ifelse(dict$curated, "TRUE", "FALSE")
rwv_write_tsv(dict, path_target("data1-field-dictionary.tsv"))
knitr::kable(head(dict[dict$sheet %in% priority, c("sheet", "field", "type", "unit_or_code", "meaning")], 8))
knitr::kable(index[, c("sheet", "rows", "figures", "content")])
```

### Task 3: Write the workbook and TSVs

```{r}
#| label: workbook
# One flat TSV per sheet, so that every file is a declared step output.
for (nm in names(tables)) rwv_write_tsv(tables[[nm]], path_target(paste0(nm, ".tsv")))
readme <- c("# Data 1 (local): sheet dictionary", "",
            "One sheet per table; tables with different units are never merged into one sheet.", "",
            "In the review bundle this file sits next to `Data1_local.xlsx`, the sheet overview",
            "`Data1_sheet_index.tsv`, the field-level dictionary `Data1_field_dictionary.tsv`",
            "(one row per sheet and field, with units and missing-value rules) and one TSV per",
            "sheet under `Data1_tables/<sheet>.tsv`. The workbook carries the same two",
            "dictionaries as its INDEX and FIELDS sheets.", "",
            paste0("| Sheet | Rows | Figures | Content |"), "|---|---:|---|---|",
            sprintf("| %s | %d | %s | %s |", index$sheet, index$rows, index$figures, index$content))
writeLines(readme, path_target("data1-README.md"), useBytes = TRUE)
# writexl is used instead of openxlsx: openxlsx 4.2.8.1 writes a sheet
# relationship pointing at xl/drawings/drawing1.xml without including that
# file, which strict readers (for example openpyxl) refuse to open.
# The workbook is a declared output, so a missing writer is an error rather
# than a silent fallback to the per-sheet TSV files.
if (!nzchar(system.file(package = "writexl"))) rwv_fail("writexl is required to write Data1_local.xlsx; see environment/README.md.")
workbook_sheets <- c(list(INDEX = index, FIELDS = dict), tables)
writexl::write_xlsx(workbook_sheets, path_target("Data1_local.xlsx"), format_headers = FALSE)
status <- data.frame(item = "Data1_local.xlsx", status = "written",
                     note = sprintf("%d data sheets plus INDEX and FIELDS (%d worksheets), written with writexl %s", length(tables),
                                    length(workbook_sheets), as.character(utils::packageVersion("writexl"))))
rwv_write_tsv(status, path_target("data1-workbook-status.tsv"))
# Read the workbook back with a different library than the one that wrote it.
back <- readxl::excel_sheets(path_target("Data1_local.xlsx"))
rwv_check(checks, "workbook sheets read back equal INDEX, FIELDS plus every sheet", c("INDEX", "FIELDS", names(tables)), back,
          source = "readxl on the written file")
one <- as.data.frame(readxl::read_xlsx(path_target("Data1_local.xlsx"), sheet = "S14_checkv_catalogue"))
rwv_check(checks, "catalogue sheet read back: rows and numeric length column", c("3060", "TRUE"),
          c(as.character(nrow(one)), as.character(is.numeric(one$contig_length_bp))),
          source = "readxl on the written file")
knitr::kable(status)
```

```{r}
                       c(step = params$name, run_id = step$run_id, mode = step$mode, quarto = rwv_quarto_version()))
```

```{r}
knitr::kable(transform(outputs, sha256 = substr(outputs$sha256, 1, 16)), caption = "Outputs recorded in step-record.json")
rwv_report_complete(step, outputs)
```
